_comment: Car smoke and skid marks. smoke: puffs per second per wheel at full skid, seconds a puff lives, radius it starts and ends at (m), how fast it rises (m/s), how fast it loses the car's speed, how thick dust off the road is next to tire smoke, and how opaque the smoke is overall. skid: what counts as a real skid; a tire smokes and marks only past driftAngleStart degrees of slip angle (full at driftAngleFull), or when spinning or locked past spinRatioStart slip ratio (full at spinRatioFull); steered wheels need steeredAngleExtra more, so front tires scrubbing in understeer leave nothing; ordinary hard cornering keeps the rear under about 11 degrees. steam: the same for an overheating engine, rate per degree over 105 C. marks: how hard a wheel must skid to leave a mark or any smoke (0..1), half the mark width, the longest straight piece (m), how sharp a turn starts a new piece (degrees), how far a wheel can jump before the mark breaks (m), and when marks start fading and are gone (s).
